mechanism: Replace full-input32-bit absolute SF predecessors with16-bit legal backward distances; zero remains no predecessor. Push distances during hashing to remove the separate zero-fill pass. Reconstruct at guarded lookup; far predecessors are discarded exactly where old search stopped.
difference_from_old_work: R19 shared match caches increased lifecycle overhead and mostly covered existing candidates. This changes predecessor representation and construction, preserving matching search policy. Unlike modular hints, explicit distancezero avoids wrap alias.
